responsibility: This definition module declares the core terminal-dispatch abstraction used by the Logitech/PIM compatibility I/O stack. It defines procedure types for reading, write output, and readiness testing, plus APIs to assign and unassign stacked handlers and to invoke the currently active terminal read, key-status, and write operations.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Termbase pair: it defines the terminal handler procedure types and the stack-management/dispatch API, while Termbase.mod implements the handler stacks and default backend setup.
